description: Header file defining the SerialPort class with configurations, enums, and interface methods for serial port communication, including platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Class representing serial port communication with platform-specific implementations, configuration options, and data transfer methods.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison based on descriptor handle.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison based on descriptor handle.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the serial port has encountered an error.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serial port buffers.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local port identifier.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote port identifier.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with a wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port with a wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the serial port (implementation-specific).

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Virtual method to send data over the serial port.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Virtual method to receive data from the serial port.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Virtual method called on state change.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with detailed parameters.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: SendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal over the serial port.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes the serial port object.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Applies the current configuration settings.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the port as opened and updates state.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Marks the port as closed and releases resources.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for port closure within a timeout.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the port (Linux).

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns event status (Linux).

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles events (Linux).

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns buffer for Linux or Windows descriptor.
